answer.summary: Architecture test TenantActiveTableAccessArchTest.asset_agent_jobs_repository_access_is_reviewed failed because this change makes AtomicTestingService access AssetAgentJobRepository directly: a new field of that type, and stop() calls deleteAllByInjectIdsAndTenantId. Rest of the 1432 tests passed.
